source_documents.title: An AIE and PET fluorescent probe for effective Zn(II) detection and imaging in living cells

reference_evidence_units.quote: the fluorescence intensity of probe L increased 50-fold from 0 % to 100 %
reference_evidence_units.subject: probe L
reference_evidence_units.conditions: 10 micromolar L, EtOH/water fraction series, Fig. 1 visually inspected.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Water addition enhances emission around 550 nm; source reports about 50-fold increase.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This is aggregation series, distinct from Zn-binding emission at 484 nm; no particle-size characterization in selected evidence.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the rotation of C = C double bond was limited to some extent
reference_evidence_units.subject: probe L aggregate mechanism
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors propose restriction of C=C rotation to explain aggregate brightening.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Preserve the specific weaker interpretation without replacing it with proven phenyl single-bond RIR; no torsional or isomerization kinetics reported.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the smoothly photoinduced electron transfer between tetrastyrene and N donor suppressed its emission.
reference_evidence_units.subject: probe L in low water fractions
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors invoke PET between the fluorophore and nitrogen donor as the low-emission pathway.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Qualitative proposal; radical-ion or ultrafast PET measurements are not shown.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the fluorescence intensity at 484 nm increased by 30-fold.
reference_evidence_units.subject: probe L with Zn(II)
reference_evidence_units.conditions: EtOH/water 4:1, 20 mM HEPES pH 7.20, excitation 416 nm.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Zn(II) increases 484 nm intensity about 30-fold; reported QY changes 0.008 to 0.034.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Relative intensity enhancement is not identical to QY ratio; absorption also changes. Methods p.3 says pH 7.40, inconsistent with results/captions.

reference_evidence_units.quote: other coexisting metal ions have little effect on the detection results, but the addition of Cu2+
reference_evidence_units.subject: probe L selectivity control
reference_evidence_units.conditions: 10 micromolar probe; competing ions 100 micromolar, Fig. 2b visually inspected.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Most tested ions do not interfere; Cu(II) suppresses the Zn-response.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Source suggests paramagnetic quenching; do not describe unconditional metal selectivity.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the probe L forms a 1: 1 complex with Zn2+.
reference_evidence_units.subject: probe L-Zn(II)
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Job plot maximum near 0.5 and mass peak m/z 588.0, Fig. 3.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors propose 1:1 complexation, supported by Job plot and assigned [L+Zn-H]+ mass peak.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: No resolved crystal structure; binding constant fit assumes this stoichiometry.

reference_evidence_units.quote: coordination of oxygen atom of phenolic hydroxyl, nitrogen atom of imine and nitrogen atom of thiazole ring
reference_evidence_units.subject: probe L-Zn(II)
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Main-text description of DMSO-d6 NMR titration, SI Fig. S13.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors propose O,N,N coordination from OH disappearance and nitrogen-adjacent proton changes.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: SI NMR not personally inspected; proton assignments and exact coordination geometry remain provisional.

reference_evidence_units.quote: due to the interruption of the PET phenomenon on pure probe L
reference_evidence_units.subject: probe L Zn-induced turn-on
reference_evidence_units.statement: Chelation is proposed to interrupt PET and restore emission.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Explicit mechanism proposal, not direct PET rate measurement; does not imply Zn-centered luminescence.

reference_evidence_units.quote: pure probes L have only weak fluorescence intensity in the pH range of 2.0- 12.0.
reference_evidence_units.subject: probe L pH control
reference_evidence_units.conditions: EtOH/water 4:1; Fig. 4; free probe versus Zn-complex.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Free L remains weak across pH 2-12, while Zn-containing samples respond strongly at pH 4.8-12.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This is sensing pH dependence, not ESIPT evidence.

reference_evidence_units.quote: After adding RPMI-1640 solution containing 100 μM Zn2+ and incubation for 15 min
reference_evidence_units.subject: probe L cellular control
reference_evidence_units.conditions: HeLa cells with L 10 micromolar, 37 C 24 h then Zn; Fig. 5.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Main results report no obvious fluorescence with L alone and blue fluorescence after Zn addition.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Methods p.4 says 100 mM zinc whereas results say 100 micromolar. Dose conflict prevents reliable biological-protocol reconstruction; endogenous Zn detection not demonstrated by this control.

reference_mechanisms.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Authors explicitly propose restricted C=C rotation in aggregates; limited mechanistic evidence, not inferred merely from AIE.

reference_mechanisms.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Zn(II) chelation is supported under broad ion-binding family; geometry and SI titration remain provisional.

reference_mechanisms.label: PET_ET
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Explicit proposed PET quenching and Zn-induced PET interruption; retain as bounded author interpretation without direct transient evidence.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Authors explicitly propose restricted C=C rotation in aggregates; limited mechanistic evidence, not inferred merely from AIE.

mechanism_decisions.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No packing, host or matrix constraint on target photophysics is established in the selected evidence.

mechanism_decisions.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Zn(II) chelation is supported under broad ion-binding family; geometry and SI titration remain provisional.

mechanism_decisions.label: ICT_TICT_CT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific charge-transfer excited-state assignment is established in the selected evidence.

mechanism_decisions.label: ESIPT_PT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No excited-state proton-transfer photophysics is established. Ground-state protonation or hydrogen bonding alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: PET_ET
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Explicit proposed PET quenching and Zn-induced PET interruption; retain as bounded author interpretation without direct transient evidence.

mechanism_decisions.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific aggregate exciton, excimer or exciplex assignment is established; aggregation or close packing alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No distinct radiative-rate or bright/dark-state balance mechanism is established beyond the other pathways; intensity and lifetime alone are insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific triplet, metal-centered or energy-transfer pathway is established; metal binding alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: RACI_CI_ACCESS
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific conical-intersection access mechanism is established.

mechanism_decisions.label: SOKR_ANTI_KASHA
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No higher-state emission or suppression of Kasha's rule is established.
